stem: Based on information in paragraphs 2 and 6 of the selection “Life on Mars,” what can the reader conclude about life on Mars?
instruction: Use “Life on Mars” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Any life that existed on Mars would be in the form of microbes.

options.label: B
options.text: Crops would be able to stay alive on Mars if water were actually available.

options.label: C
options.text: Scientists are far from determining whether Mars ever supported life.

options.label: D
options.text: People exploring Mars are unsure of how to identify living microbes.
